entries.label: Constant
entries.doc: A fixed, editable scalar value.

entries.label: Stochastic
entries.doc: A random draw from a distribution, resampled per realization.

entries.label: Time Series
entries.doc: A tabulated signal over time, interpolated between points.

entries.label: Lookup Table
entries.doc: A y = f(x) table, interpolated — maps one signal through a curve.

entries.label: Expression
entries.doc: A formula over other elements, evaluated each step.

entries.label: Logic Gate
entries.doc: Boolean AND / OR / at-least-k over referenced elements' states.

entries.label: Smoothing / Filter
entries.doc: A rolling-window statistic (mean / min / max / sum / EMA) of an input.

entries.label: PID Controller
entries.doc: A proportional-integral-derivative controller driving an input toward a setpoint.

entries.label: Terminal Value
entries.doc: A value evaluated once at the end of the run (a terminal reduction).

entries.label: Stock / Reservoir
entries.doc: Accumulates its inflows minus outflows each step (an integrator).

entries.label: Previous Value (delay)
entries.doc: The value of an input one step ago (a unit delay).

entries.label: Convolution
entries.doc: Convolves an input with an impulse-response kernel (a distributed delay).

entries.label: Queue
entries.doc: A material delay: an input emerges after a transit time (conveyor / FIFO).

entries.label: Failure / Event
entries.doc: A state machine that fires on a condition or schedule (0 = operating, 1 = failed).

entries.label: Status (latch)
entries.doc: A latch flipped on/off by set and reset triggers.

entries.label: Milestone
entries.doc: Fires once when its trigger condition first becomes true.

entries.label: Hysteresis
entries.doc: A Schmitt trigger: switches between two outputs at high / low thresholds.

entries.label: Stochastic Process (GBM/OU)
entries.doc: A geometric-Brownian / mean-reverting continuous process.

entries.label: Markov Chain
entries.doc: A discrete-state chain with a transition matrix and per-state outputs.

entries.label: Resource
entries.doc: A finite pool consumed and replenished by links.

entries.label: Cell
entries.doc: A well-mixed compartment holding species in media.

entries.label: Species
entries.doc: A transported species, optionally decaying into daughters.

entries.label: Medium
entries.doc: A phase (solid / fluid / gas) that species partition into.

entries.label: Link (transfer)
entries.doc: A transfer of mass between cells or resources.
